nowPanelBoardAskQueue: Start automatically? {key} can begin at once and spends your plan's allowance.
nowPanelBoardAskStart: Start {key} now? It spends your plan's allowance; what it waits on is checked again first.
nowPanelBoardAskStartAgain: Start {key} again? Its crewmate carries on in the same conversation and spends your plan's allowance.
nowPanelBoardBroughtCard: Brought its merge card forward. Only the card's own button merges.
nowPanelBoardCannotMove: This board cannot move tasks here.
nowPanelBoardCannotPin: This board cannot pin tasks here.
nowPanelBoardCardGone: Its merge card is no longer up.
nowPanelBoardDoneContinued: {key}'s crewmate was told to carry on.
nowPanelBoardDonePinned: {key} is pinned to the top of Tasks.
nowPanelBoardDoneQueued: {key} is queued. It may start at once.
nowPanelBoardDoneStartedAgain: {key} started again as a new task.
nowPanelBoardDoneStopped: {key} dropped. A copy of its unfinished work is kept.
nowPanelBoardDoneUnqueued: {key} moved to Backlog. It waits for your word; its work, blockers and holds stay.
nowPanelBoardDragStarted: Drag to a column. Each one says what the drop would do.
nowPanelBoardDropAsks: Drop task asks once. Cancel writes nothing.
nowPanelBoardDropChanged: {key} changed. Look at it again before dropping it.
nowPanelBoardEarlierCapped: The search stops at its newest matches. Type more of a key or title to narrow them.
nowPanelBoardEarlierUnavailable: Earlier results are unavailable right now. Done · 7d still lists this week’s.
nowPanelBoardLandedAsks: The tile landed and asks once. Cancel returns it.
nowPanelBoardMenuContinueDetail: Picks the work up where it stopped
nowPanelBoardMenuQueueAskDetail: May start at once · asks once
nowPanelBoardMenuQueueBlockedDetail: Starts by itself once {waitsOn} is done · at once
nowPanelBoardMenuQueueHeldDetail: Starts by itself once its hold ends · at once
nowPanelBoardMenuStopDetail: Stops its turn, keeps its work · at once
nowPanelBoardMenuUnqueueDetail: Waits for your word again · at once
nowPanelBoardMoveAlreadyHere: Already here. The order follows priority and age, so this drop changes nothing.
nowPanelBoardMoveAlreadyQueued: It is already queued to start by itself. A drag cannot force a start.
nowPanelBoardMoveAnswerCardFirst: Answer its card first. Moving it cannot dismiss that decision.
nowPanelBoardMoveBlockedMany: {waitsOn} must finish first. The dependencies stay.
nowPanelBoardMoveBlockedOne: {waitsOn} must finish first. The dependency stays.
nowPanelBoardMoveCannotDrop: This task cannot be dropped here. Open its record instead.
nowPanelBoardMoveChanged: {key} changed, so the move was cancelled. Nothing was written.
nowPanelBoardMoveClosed: Closed work stays where it is. Open its record instead.
nowPanelBoardMoveHeld: It is held, so a drag cannot start it. Its record's Start can.
nowPanelBoardMoveNoMergeCard: No merge card is up for it, so nothing can finish it from here.
nowPanelBoardMoveNotWaiting: Only a ready decision puts a task in Waiting on you.
nowPanelBoardMoveParentStart: Its parts are already planned. Start a part, not the container.
nowPanelBoardMoveParentToBacklog: Its parts are the work. Move a part, not the container.
nowPanelBoardMoveParentToQueue: Its parts are the work. Queue a part, not the container.
nowPanelBoardMoveQueuedBlocked: Queued at once. It starts on its own once {waitsOn} is done.
nowPanelBoardMoveQueuedHeld: Queued at once. It starts on its own once its hold ends.
nowPanelBoardMoveShowsMergeCard: Brings its merge card forward. The card merges; the drop never does.
nowPanelBoardMoveStartedInBacklog: It has already started. Start picks it up from the backlog.
nowPanelBoardMoveToBacklog: It now waits for your word. Its blockers and holds stay.
nowPanelBoardMoveWaitsForYou: It waits for you. Open its record; moving it cannot answer that wait.
nowPanelBoardMovedQueuedBlocked: {key} moved to Queued. It starts on its own once {waitsOn} is done.
nowPanelBoardMovedQueuedHeld: {key} moved to Queued. It starts on its own once its hold ends.
nowPanelBoardMovedStartedToBacklog: {key} moved to Backlog. Its work is kept; Start picks it up.
nowPanelBoardMovedToBacklog: {key} moved to Backlog. It waits for your word; its blockers and holds stay.
nowPanelBoardOffBoard: {key} is no longer on the board.
nowPanelBoardPinDetail: Keeps it at the top of Tasks · at once
nowPanelBoardStartedBacklogText: Its turn stops and its work stays. It waits for your Start.
nowPanelBoardUnpinDetail: Lists it under its state in Tasks again · at once
